versions.content: The DET module shall forward its trace events to the DLT Description: The DET receives trace events from errors from the BSW and application during debugging time. If a DLT module exists, these events should be forwarded to the DLT to collect logs and traces only in one instance. Rationale: To have an overview of all log, trace and error messages and to set all of them in the correct context, it is important to have all these messages and events in one list (context). Also it is not practicable to use more than one mechanism to report errors, logs and traces to a debugging interface. So all these sources should be routed to the DLT. Use Case: • A debugging scenario, an application or BSW Module uses the DET interface to trace an error • This error is forwarded by the DET to the DLT • The DLT turns these events in the DLT format and sends it over the debugging interface, together with all the other logs and traces AppliesTo: CP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
